title: ToT Mode E1M2 Challenge
wikitext:
{{Tabs static |name1=Overview |link1=ToT_Mode |name2=E1M2 |link2=ToT_Mode_E1M2_Challenge |name3=DM4 |link3=ToT_Mode_DM4_Challenge |This=2 }} The idea behind this challenge is to play a five-minute FFA round in e1m2 against level 20 bots without dying a single time while still getting as many frags as possible. The bots spawn with 0/100 and only use the shotgun unless they're going for a rocket jump. The player starts with the standard dmm4 stack but both LG and GL are disabled. Some people think SNG should not be allowed, but that rule hasn't been set in stone. The ToT Mode initially had quad damage multiplier of eight instead of four, and nearly countless hours of grinding occurred before an option to change the damage multiplier was added. Thus many/most/all(?) records in this specific challenge have been made with the quad multiplier set to eight. ==Settings== 
k_fb_quad_multiplier 8
k_fb_break_on_death 1
set dq 0
set k_pow 1
timelimit 5
deathmatch 4

KTS respawns
noweapon: gl, lg, (sng?)
bot weapon: sg
bot health: 100
bot skill: 20
